title: cost-pilot: runtime-driven batching + quantization suggester
author: Priya Gupta
description:
Motivation: operators frequently pick conservative batching and quantization settings that leave money on the table. This PR introduces Cost Pilot, a runtime-driven suggester that analyzes recent request distributions and model family characteristics to propose safe batching defaults, KV/prefix cache presets, and quantization profiles (int8/4-bit recommendations) per-model. Goals: 1) provide non-invasive suggestions (opt-in) that reduce per-token cost while keeping p95 latency within SLO; 2) wire the suggester into the Console recommendations UI and the Optimize pipeline; 3) add a small, reproducible simulation harness for validating suggestion impact on unit economics.

What this PR contains: - A runtime telemetry consumer that computes a compact fingerprint of sequence length distribution, concurrency, and cache hit patterns; - Heuristics engine that maps fingerprints to suggested batching window, concurrency cap, cache presets, and quant profile; - Safe-apply mode that produces a rollout plan (canary -> ramp -> full) with expected cost delta and estimated latency impact; - Console API endpoint and a CLI helper (redwood optimize suggest) to preview and export suggestions; - Unit tests, simulation harness, and an integration test that runs the suggester on synthetic traffic.

Compatibility and rollout: suggestions are completely non-destructive by default. The Console exposes an \"Apply suggestion\" flow which either writes a canary policy (route-level override) or a full model config. We added feature flag optimize.cost_pilot.enabled to gate production rollout. Suggested values are conservative: initial quant recommendations keep a float fallback for catastrophic drift detection.

Checklist: - [x] Telemetry consumer and fingerprinting - [x] Heuristics core and quant profile mapper - [x] Suggestion export + CLI - [x] Console endpoint + minimal UI wiring (server-side only) - [x] Tests and simulation harness - [x] Documentation: docs/usage/cost-pilot.md - [x] Added Linear tickets where needed

Related: Linear: ENG-4829, ENG-4906, ENG-4932. A follow-up will add automatic A/B evaluation harness and a feedback loop to record production quality regressions for quant suggestions. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4829/cost-pilot-design (internal).
